chapters.Hook: 从文本到运行中的进程
chapters.Allocators: 7. 五个分配器，一条真实轨迹
chapters.Theory: 8. 克努特法则与罗布森界
chapters.Outro: 回顾、习题，以及它们会在哪里再出现

b6bffd61b5a4.en: Until now every Pebble program has been one file of assembly, written by hand, that the machine runs from address zero. Real programs are not like that. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here is the Job again, written the way a compiler would write it: four separate files. The main loop; the word table, now a linked list of nodes on a heap; a memory allocator; and the input and output routines. Each is assembled on its own, and each has holes in it: places where it uses a name, like lookup or alloc, whose address it cannot know. <bookmark mark='b'/> A linker fills the holes and joins the four into one program. <bookmark mark='c'/> It prints exactly the same twenty words as Part 6's program, and on the first chapter it is even a little faster.
b6bffd61b5a4.zh: 到目前为止，每个 Pebble 程序都是一个手写的汇编文件，机器从地址零开始运行它。真实的程序不是这样的。<bookmark mark='a'/>这又是任务，按编译器会写的方式写成：四个独立的文件。主循环；单词表，现在是堆上节点组成的链表；一个内存分配器；以及输入输出例程。每个文件单独汇编，每个都留着洞：在那些地方它用到一个名字，比如 lookup 或 alloc，却不可能知道它的地址。<bookmark mark='b'/>链接器把这些洞填上，把四个文件合成一个程序。<bookmark mark='c'/>它打印的二十个词和第6部分的程序一模一样，在第一章上甚至还快一点。

977a742b7d06.en: And here is a program that does something its author never wrote. <bookmark mark='a'/> It asks for a name and says hello, copying the name into a buffer of sixty-four bytes. <bookmark mark='b'/> Give it a name, and it greets you. <bookmark mark='c'/> Give it eighty-one carefully chosen bytes, and it prints pwned, a word that appears nowhere in the program. <bookmark mark='d'/> The input ran past the end of the buffer, overwrote the address the function was going to return to, and the processor returned into the input itself. To see how, and how to stop it, we need to know how a running program is laid out in memory.
977a742b7d06.zh: 这里还有一个程序，它会做作者从没写过的事。<bookmark mark='a'/>它问你的名字，然后打招呼，把名字复制进一个六十四字节的缓冲区。<bookmark mark='b'/>给它一个名字，它就向你问好。<bookmark mark='c'/>给它八十一个精心挑选的字节，它就打印出 pwned，一个程序里根本没有的词。<bookmark mark='d'/>输入越过了缓冲区的末尾，覆盖了函数将要返回的地址，处理器就返回到了输入本身里面。要看懂这是怎么回事、又怎样阻止它，我们得先知道一个运行中的程序在内存里是怎样布局的。

0c428451993d.en: This is Part 11 of Computer Science, Built, and the first part of Act Three, Speaking to the Machine. <bookmark mark='a'/> In this part: a program's life from source to process. Bytes, endianness and alignment, and control flow as machine code. The call stack, calling conventions, recursion and tail calls. The heap and its allocators, with Knuth's fifty-percent rule and Robson's bound. Object files, static and dynamic linking, and the address space. Undefined behaviour, the stack smash, and the Job, linked from four files.
0c428451993d.zh: 这是《计算机科学，从零搭建》的第11部分，第三幕“和机器对话”的第一部分。<bookmark mark='a'/>这一部分讲：程序从源代码到进程的一生。字节、字节序和对齐，以及机器码里的控制流。调用栈、调用约定、递归和尾调用。堆和它的分配器，以及克努特的五十百分比法则和罗布森界。目标文件、静态和动态链接，以及地址空间。未定义行为、栈溢出攻击，以及由四个文件链接起来的任务。

ae388bd0179b.en: Follow the build pipeline from text to a process. <bookmark mark='a'/> Source code describes the program in a language. <bookmark mark='b'/> A compiler can translate it into assembly; Part 13 builds that stage. Real toolchains may combine stages or use an intermediate representation. <bookmark mark='c'/> The assembler encodes instructions and records unresolved symbols as relocations in an object file. <bookmark mark='d'/> The linker combines objects and libraries, lays out sections and resolves references that can be fixed at link time. Dynamic references can remain for later. <bookmark mark='e'/> On Linux, the loader maps the executable's segments, arranges zero-filled memory and an initial stack, and transfers control to the entry point or dynamic linker. Runtime startup eventually calls main. Mapping need not read every file page immediately; demand paging comes in Part 32.
ae388bd0179b.zh: 沿着构建流程，从文本走到进程。<bookmark mark='a'/>源代码用一种语言描述程序。<bookmark mark='b'/>编译器可以把它译成汇编，第13部分会搭建这一阶段。实际工具链也可能合并阶段或使用中间表示。<bookmark mark='c'/>汇编器编码指令，并把未解决的符号引用记成目标文件中的重定位。<bookmark mark='d'/>链接器组合目标文件和库，安排节的位置，解决链接时能确定的引用；动态引用可以留到以后。<bookmark mark='e'/>在 Linux 上，装载器映射可执行文件的段，安排清零内存和初始栈，再把控制权交给入口或动态链接器。运行时启动代码最终调用 main。映射不等于立即读取所有文件页；第32部分会讲按需分页。

9113b63ea413.en: Memory has byte addresses, while many values span several bytes. <bookmark mark='a'/> A 32-bit word occupies four bytes; endianness specifies their order. <bookmark mark='b'/> Big-endian puts the most significant byte at the lowest address. Many network protocols use this network byte order; each protocol defines its own encoding. <bookmark mark='c'/> Little-endian puts the least significant byte first. x86, the usual Arm configuration and our Pebble use it. The compiled host probe displays zero D, zero C, zero B, zero A for hexadecimal zero A zero B zero C zero D. <bookmark mark='d'/> Danny Cohen's 1980 essay borrowed the names from Gulliver's Travels. Neither order changes the value when decoded consistently; a format mismatch changes what the same bytes mean.
9113b63ea413.zh: 内存按字节寻址，而许多数值占多个字节。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个32位字占四字节，端序规定它们的顺序。<bookmark mark='b'/>大端把最高有效字节放在最低地址。许多网络协议使用这种网络字节序，但每种协议都有自己的编码规范。<bookmark mark='c'/>小端先放最低有效字节。x86、通常配置的 Arm 和我们的 Pebble 都如此。编译运行的主机探针把十六进制零A零B零C零D显示为零D、零C、零B、零A。<bookmark mark='d'/>丹尼·科恩1980年的文章从《格列佛游记》借来了这些名字。只要编码和解码一致，两种顺序都表达同一个值；格式不匹配才会改变同一串字节的含义。

fc6778651200.en: An array gives indexing a regular address calculation. <bookmark mark='a'/> Take a C array with three rows and four columns of four-byte integers. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its rows are consecutive: row-major order. Fortran normally uses column-major order; other languages may instead store references to separate row objects. <bookmark mark='c'/> Within this C array, element i, j starts at base plus four times the quantity four i plus j. <bookmark mark='d'/> In C, adding one to a typed pointer advances by the size of its element, and a of i is defined through pointer addition and dereference. These operations have object-bound and lifetime rules: a pointer is more than an unrestricted permission to access any numeric address. Our basic Pebble hardware does not check an array's logical bounds; the Frontier adds a toy capability check.
fc6778651200.zh: 数组让索引对应规则的地址计算。<bookmark mark='a'/>考虑三行四列的 C 数组，每个整数四字节。<bookmark mark='b'/>它逐行连续存储，称为行主序。Fortran 通常采用列主序；其他语言也可能存放指向独立行对象的引用。<bookmark mark='c'/>在这个 C 数组内，元素 i、j 的地址是基址加四乘以括号中的四 i 加 j。<bookmark mark='d'/>C 的有类型指针加一，会前进一个元素的大小；a 下标 i 由指针相加和解引用定义。这些操作受对象边界和生命周期约束，指针并不意味着可以任意访问任何数值地址。基础 Pebble 硬件不检查数组的逻辑边界；前沿章节会添加玩具能力检查。

619a9e122653.en: Chapter three. Control flow in machine code.
619a9e122653.zh: 第三章。机器码里的控制流。

a7136cf78b78.en: Structured control flow disappears in machine code: everything becomes a branch. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here are two pieces of the Job, in C-like source on the left and Pebble on the right. <bookmark mark='b'/> An if becomes a conditional branch around its body. And notice the trick for the range test: subtract A, and then one unsigned comparison against 26 asks both questions at once, because anything below A wraps round to a huge unsigned number. Compilers do this routinely. <bookmark mark='c'/> A loop becomes a test at the top that leaves, and a jump back at the bottom.
a7136cf78b78.zh: 结构化的控制流在机器码里消失了：一切都变成分支。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是任务的两段，左边是类 C 的源代码，右边是 Pebble。<bookmark mark='b'/>if 变成绕过它主体的条件分支。注意那个范围测试的技巧：先减去 A，然后一次与 26 的无符号比较同时回答两个问题，因为任何小于 A 的值都会绕回成一个巨大的无符号数。编译器经常这样做。<bookmark mark='c'/>循环变成顶部一个决定是否离开的测试，加上底部一个跳回去的跳转。

efcb754a79d9.en: Dense switch cases can use a jump table. <bookmark mark='a'/> This is the actual gcc output for eight cases on our x86-64 host. Different targets, options and case patterns can produce a different lowering. <bookmark mark='b'/> One unsigned bounds comparison rejects values outside zero through seven. <bookmark mark='c'/> The code loads a signed relative offset from the table, then adds the table's base address. Computing an address with lea is not a second data-memory load. <bookmark mark='d'/> An indirect jump transfers control to the selected case. The instruction count alone does not determine latency: prediction and memory matter too. <bookmark mark='e'/> Each case ends with a jump to its function because that call is in tail position. Its result goes straight back to our caller; chapter five explains when this transformation is valid.
efcb754a79d9.zh: 紧密排列的 switch 分支可以使用跳转表。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是本机 x86-64 上 gcc 对八个分支的实际输出。目标、选项和分支分布不同，转换方式也可能不同。<bookmark mark='b'/>一次无符号边界比较排除零到七之外的数值。<bookmark mark='c'/>代码从表里加载有符号相对偏移，再加上表的基址。lea 计算地址，并不是第二次数据内存加载。<bookmark mark='d'/>间接跳转转入所选分支。仅凭指令数不能决定延迟，预测和存储也有影响。<bookmark mark='e'/>每个分支以跳转到函数结束，因为调用位于尾位置，结果直接返回原调用者。第五章会解释这种变换何时有效。

4d77d65d1f7c.en: Separately compiled functions need a shared calling convention. This table specifies Pebble's contract. <bookmark mark='a'/> Arguments use a0 through a5, a0 returns a value, and call writes the return address into ra. <bookmark mark='b'/> A caller preserves any t-register or argument register whose old value it still needs after a call. A callee that changes s0 through s2 restores their incoming values before returning. Stack alignment must meet the convention at the required boundaries. <bookmark mark='c'/> The hardware executes instructions; interoperability depends on following the same ABI. Real conventions depend on architecture and operating system: System V AMD64 on many Unix systems, Microsoft x64, RISC-V's psABI and Apple's platform conventions. Mixing conventions requires an explicit bridge.
4d77d65d1f7c.zh: 分别编译的函数需要共同的调用约定。表中规定的是 Pebble 的契约。<bookmark mark='a'/>参数用 a0 到 a5，a0 返回结果，call 把返回地址写入 ra。<bookmark mark='b'/>调用者必须保存调用后还需要的临时寄存器或参数寄存器旧值。被调用者若修改 s0 到 s2，就要在返回前恢复传入值。栈对齐必须在约定要求的边界上满足规则。<bookmark mark='c'/>硬件只执行指令，互操作依赖一致的 ABI。实际约定取决于架构和操作系统，例如许多 Unix 系统的 System V AMD64、Microsoft x64、RISC-V 的 psABI 和苹果平台约定。混用约定需要明确的桥接。

1458acf1f2a6.en: Watch it on a recursive function, the factorial. <bookmark mark='a'/> fact of ten calls fact of nine, which calls fact of eight, and so on down to one, each call pushing a frame holding its own n and its return address. <bookmark mark='b'/> Here is the stack's depth, measured on Pebble's emulator instruction by instruction: it climbs to ten frames, then, as each call returns and multiplies, it unwinds to nothing. <bookmark mark='c'/> The result is ten factorial, and the deepest the stack went was a hundred and sixty bytes.
1458acf1f2a6.zh: 在一个递归函数上看看，阶乘。<bookmark mark='a'/>fact(10) 调用 fact(9)，后者调用 fact(8)，一直到一，每次调用压入一个帧，装着它自己的 n 和返回地址。<bookmark mark='b'/>这是在 Pebble 模拟器上逐条指令测出的栈深度：它爬升到十个帧，然后随着每次调用返回并相乘，退回到零。<bookmark mark='c'/>结果是十的阶乘，栈最深时是一百六十个字节。

c3286285c209.en: A debugger reads the same structure on a real machine. <bookmark mark='a'/> We compiled a C factorial on this computer, ran it under gdb, and stopped it at its deepest call, fact of one. <bookmark mark='b'/> Asked for a backtrace, gdb lists six frames: five calls of fact and main. <bookmark mark='c'/> It finds them by walking the stack. Each frame keeps its caller's frame address and its own return address, so from the stack pointer the debugger can step from frame to frame. The stack pointers it reports are thirty-two bytes apart, one frame of fact each. <bookmark mark='d'/> And the saved return addresses tell the story of the calls: four of them point to the same instruction in fact, the one just after the recursive call; the fifth returns into main, and main's into the C library that started it. That is all a backtrace is.
c3286285c209.zh: 调试器在真实的机器上读的是同一个结构。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们在这台计算机上编译了一个 C 写的阶乘，在 gdb 里运行，让它停在最深的那次调用，fact(1)。<bookmark mark='b'/>要它给出回溯，gdb 列出六个栈帧：五次 fact 调用和 main。<bookmark mark='c'/>它是沿着栈走过去找到它们的。每个栈帧都保存着调用者的帧地址和自己的返回地址，所以调试器从栈指针出发，就能一帧一帧地走。它报告的栈指针彼此相差三十二个字节，每个是 fact 的一个栈帧。<bookmark mark='d'/>保存的返回地址讲出了这串调用的故事：其中四个指向 fact 里的同一条指令，也就是递归调用之后的那一条；第五个返回进 main，而 main 的返回进启动它的 C 库。回溯不过如此。

e230aa3ee6f1.en: Chapter five. Recursion, depth, and tail calls.
e230aa3ee6f1.zh: 第五章。递归、深度与尾调用。

f7fd46cb3fd5.en: A small recursive definition can demand a large call tree. <bookmark mark='a'/> This two-argument Ackermann variant has three rules. As a function of both arguments it is computable but not primitive recursive: no fixed nesting of bounded loops computes all its values. That is a computability classification, not a ban on while-loop implementations. <bookmark mark='b'/> Our Pebble run for A of three, six returns 509 after 172,233 calls, with 511 frames at maximum depth. Work counts every call; depth counts only the longest active chain. <bookmark mark='c'/> A of four, two equals two to the 65,536 minus three, a value with 19,729 decimal digits. The experiment demonstrates both enormous work and stack demand; it does not compute that larger case by naive recursion.
f7fd46cb3fd5.zh: 很小的递归定义也能产生巨大的调用树。<bookmark mark='a'/>这个双参数阿克曼函数变体只有三条规则。作为两个参数的函数，它可计算，却不是原始递归函数：固定嵌套层数的有界循环不能计算它的全部取值。这是可计算性分类，并不禁止用 while 循环实现。<bookmark mark='b'/>Pebble 上 A 三、六返回509，共调用172,233次，最大深度511个栈帧。工作量统计所有调用，深度只统计最长的活动调用链。<bookmark mark='c'/>A 四、二等于二的65,536次方减三，有19,729位十进制数字。实验展示巨大的工作量和栈需求，并未用朴素递归计算这个更大的实例。

644111f3bf95.en: Stack limits depend on the process, thread and runtime. <bookmark mark='a'/> Eight megabytes is a common Linux soft limit for the main thread's stack, and one megabyte a common Windows executable default; neither is a universal constant, and thread stacks can be configured. <bookmark mark='b'/> Guard pages can make an access beyond a stack boundary fault. Large unchecked jumps can skip a guard, so stack probing and stack-clash protections matter too. <bookmark mark='c'/> CPython has a configurable recursion limit, commonly around a thousand. Java can report StackOverflowError; the available depth depends on stack size and frame sizes. <bookmark mark='d'/> Mutual recursion consumes frames just as direct recursion does. <bookmark mark='e'/> An explicit heap worklist or an iterative algorithm can control call-stack growth, but it still needs memory for pending work.
644111f3bf95.zh: 栈限制取决于进程、线程和运行时。<bookmark mark='a'/>八兆字节是 Linux 主线程常见的软限制，一兆字节是 Windows 可执行文件常见的默认值；它们都不是普遍常数，线程栈也可以配置。<bookmark mark='b'/>保护页能让越过栈边界的访问触发故障，但未经检查的大幅跳跃可能跨过保护页，所以还需要栈探测和栈碰撞防护。<bookmark mark='c'/>CPython 有可配置的递归限制，通常约一千层。Java 可以报告 StackOverflowError；可用深度取决于栈大小和栈帧大小。<bookmark mark='d'/>相互递归与直接递归一样消耗栈帧。<bookmark mark='e'/>显式的堆工作表或迭代算法可以控制调用栈增长，但待处理工作仍然需要内存。

0a354a7cc5ec.en: The stack naturally serves data whose lifetime follows a call. <bookmark mark='a'/> Many objects have different lifetimes. <bookmark mark='b'/> The Job's word table survives the functions that add entries, and its eventual size depends on input. <bookmark mark='c'/> Dynamic allocation requests storage whose lifetime lasts until it is released. In C, malloc may fail and return null; a successful allocation does not initialize its bytes. After free, aliases no longer authorize access to that object. <bookmark mark='d'/> Our allocator handles requests online, without future knowledge. With ordinary raw pointers it cannot transparently relocate a live block: existing pointers would still name its old location. Moving collectors and handle-based systems use extra machinery to update or redirect references.
0a354a7cc5ec.zh: 栈很适合生命周期随调用结束的数据。<bookmark mark='a'/>许多对象却有不同的生命周期。<bookmark mark='b'/>任务的词表比添加条目的函数活得更久，最终大小取决于输入。<bookmark mark='c'/>动态分配请求一块存储，其生命周期延续到释放为止。在 C 中，malloc 可能失败并返回空指针；分配成功也不会初始化字节。free 后，别名不再授权访问该对象。<bookmark mark='d'/>分配器在线处理请求，不知道未来。面对普通裸指针，它不能透明搬动活动块，否则现有指针仍指向旧位置。移动式收集器和基于句柄的系统，需要额外机制更新或重定向引用。

db1171a94f33.en: This diagram explains a classic free-list design. <bookmark mark='a'/> Divide storage into blocks with metadata recording size and allocation state. <bookmark mark='b'/> Link the free blocks into a searchable structure. <bookmark mark='c'/> To allocate, find a sufficiently large hole and split it if the remainder can form a useful free block. The request must first account for metadata and alignment. <bookmark mark='d'/> To free, coalesce adjacent free blocks. This reduces separated holes but cannot combine holes across a live object. <bookmark mark='e'/> Boundary tags record information at block boundaries so a neighbor can be found efficiently. The Python simulator represents those relationships with dictionaries and ordered lists: its eight-byte-header accounting does not charge a literal footer or reproduce native execution time.
db1171a94f33.zh: 这张图解释经典空闲链表设计。<bookmark mark='a'/>把存储分成块，用元数据记录大小和分配状态。<bookmark mark='b'/>把空闲块连成可搜索的结构。<bookmark mark='c'/>分配时找到足够大的空洞，若余量能形成有用的空闲块就拆分；请求首先要计入元数据和对齐。<bookmark mark='d'/>释放时合并相邻空闲块，能减少分散空洞，却不能跨过活动对象合并。<bookmark mark='e'/>边界标签在块边界记录信息，以高效找到邻居。Python 模拟器用字典和有序列表表达这些关系；它按八字节头部计费，没有另计真实尾部，也不复现原生执行时间。

e8315b0c7561.en: Chapter seven. Five allocators, one real trace.
e8315b0c7561.zh: 第七章。五个分配器，一条真实轨迹。

d20a20e48bbf.en: When several free blocks would do, which should a request get? <bookmark mark='a'/> First fit takes the first one it finds, in address order. Next fit does the same but starts each search where the last one stopped, so it does not keep re-scanning the front. Best fit takes the smallest block that fits, leaving the biggest pieces intact. Segregated fits keeps a separate list for each size class and looks in the request's own class first. And the buddy system allows only blocks whose sizes are powers of two, which makes splitting and merging almost free. <bookmark mark='b'/> We implemented all five on the same simulated heap and replayed Perl's trace through each.
d20a20e48bbf.zh: 当好几个空闲块都可以时，一个请求该给哪一个？<bookmark mark='a'/>首次适配按地址顺序取它找到的第一个。下次适配做法一样，但每次搜索都从上次停下的地方开始，免得一遍遍重扫前面。最佳适配取能放下的最小的块，让最大的块保持完整。分离适配为每个大小类别各留一个链表，先在请求自己的类别里找。伙伴系统只允许大小为二的幂的块，这让切分和合并几乎不花代价。<bookmark mark='b'/>我们在同一个模拟的堆上实现了全部五种，把 Perl 的轨迹逐一重放给它们。

ed3891eceef9.en: These results describe one recorded trace and our simulator's rules. <bookmark mark='a'/> The ratio is peak heap size divided by peak requested live bytes. These peaks need not occur at the same instant. The ratio includes metadata, alignment, rounding and unused holes; it is not external fragmentation alone. <bookmark mark='b'/> First fit, best fit and segregated fits are near 1.13 here. Next fit is slightly larger, and buddy is about 1.82, or 82 percent above peak requested live bytes. The trace does not isolate how much each overhead contributes. A universal quarter-waste rule would require a request-size distribution. <bookmark mark='c'/> The other panel counts blocks examined per allocation. Next fit examines about eighteen, and segregated fits fewer than one on average because some requests extend the heap without a search. These are operation counts, not measured execution times. <bookmark mark='d'/> Size classes can reduce searching, but real performance also depends on synchronization, locality, metadata and workload. One trace does not rank every allocator for every program.
ed3891eceef9.zh: 结果描述的是一条记录轨迹和模拟器规则。<bookmark mark='a'/>比值为堆大小峰值除以用户请求的活动字节峰值，两者不一定发生在同一时刻。它包含元数据、对齐、取整和空洞，并非仅有外部碎片。<bookmark mark='b'/>这里首次适配、最佳适配和分离适配约为1.13，下一次适配略大，伙伴系统约为1.82，即比活动请求峰值多82%。这条轨迹并未分离各类开销的贡献；普遍的四分之一浪费结论需要指定请求大小分布。<bookmark mark='c'/>另一栏统计每次分配检查的块数。下一次适配约十八个，分离适配平均不到一个，因为一些请求无需搜索就扩展堆。这是操作计数，不是实测执行时间。<bookmark mark='d'/>大小类别能减少搜索，但实际性能还取决于同步、局部性、元数据和负载。一条轨迹不能替所有程序给分配器排名。

69881491e04d.en: A binary buddy allocator splits power-of-two blocks. <bookmark mark='a'/> In our simulator a sixteen-byte payload needs an eight-byte header and alignment, so it occupies a thirty-two-byte block. Split 256 into 128, 64 and 32, leaving the other half free at each level. <bookmark mark='b'/> With addresses measured relative to an aligned arena, a block's buddy is its address exclusive-or its block size. This identifies its partner, not an arbitrary adjacent free block. <bookmark mark='c'/> Merge only when that partner is free and has the same size; repeat at the next level. <bookmark mark='d'/> The arithmetic is simple, but splitting, lookup and merging still have costs. A twenty-five-byte payload plus the header crosses the thirty-two-byte class and needs sixty-four bytes here. Waste within an allocated block is internal fragmentation; separated free holes contribute external fragmentation.
69881491e04d.zh: 二进制伙伴分配器把二的幂大小的块对半拆分。<bookmark mark='a'/>在模拟器中，十六字节载荷加八字节头部，再对齐后占三十二字节块。把256依次拆成128、64和32，每一层留下另一半空闲。<bookmark mark='b'/>以对齐内存区为基准计算相对地址时，块地址与块大小异或就得到伙伴地址。这找到的是指定伙伴，并非任意相邻空闲块。<bookmark mark='c'/>只有伙伴空闲且大小相同才合并，再向上一层重复。<bookmark mark='d'/>地址运算简单，但拆分、查找和合并仍有成本。二十五字节载荷加头部越过三十二字节类别，在这里需要六十四字节。已分配块内部的浪费是内部碎片；分散的空洞造成外部碎片。

8290f69d6e9f.en: Production allocators combine policies with concurrency and locality mechanisms. <bookmark mark='a'/> glibc's ptmalloc uses size-organized bins, coalescing and boundary metadata, with caches and multiple arenas. Details vary by release. <bookmark mark='b'/> jemalloc, tcmalloc and mimalloc use size classes and local fast paths. Their ownership differs: some configurations use thread caches, others CPU-local or page-local structures. They are not identical designs. <bookmark mark='c'/> Large requests may use separate operating-system mappings rather than extending a contiguous brk heap, depending on policy and thresholds. <bookmark mark='d'/> Local caches can reduce shared-list contention, at a cost in retained memory and cross-thread transfer complexity. Part 10's coherence lessons explain one part of that tradeoff. <bookmark mark='e'/> Garbage-collected runtimes decide when unreachable objects can be reclaimed, while still relying on allocation machinery. Part 15 builds those mechanisms.
8290f69d6e9f.zh: 生产分配器把分配策略与并发、局部性机制结合。<bookmark mark='a'/>glibc 的 ptmalloc 使用按大小组织的空闲箱、合并和边界元数据，也有缓存与多个内存区，细节随版本变化。<bookmark mark='b'/>jemalloc、tcmalloc 和 mimalloc 使用大小类别与局部快速路径，但所有权组织不同：有些配置使用线程缓存，有些采用每 CPU 或每页结构，并不是同一种设计。<bookmark mark='c'/>大请求可能使用独立的操作系统映射，而不是扩展连续 brk 堆，取决于策略和阈值。<bookmark mark='d'/>局部缓存能减少共享链表竞争，代价是保留内存及跨线程传递更复杂。第10部分的一致性知识解释了部分取舍。<bookmark mark='e'/>垃圾收集运行时判断不可达对象何时可回收，同时仍依赖分配机制。第15部分会搭建这些机制。

ff570514bada.en: Chapter eight. Knuth's rule and Robson's bound.
ff570514bada.zh: 第八章。克努特法则与罗布森界。

c2157c8bd8f4.en: Knuth's fifty-percent rule is a statistical balance argument under specific assumptions. <bookmark mark='a'/> Consider a roughly stationary, coalescing heap with N live blocks and uniformly selected frees. Let p be the probability that allocation splits an existing free hole. Ignore boundary and heap-growth corrections in this simplified derivation. <bookmark mark='b'/> Classify live blocks as A, B or C when zero, one or two neighbors are free. <bookmark mark='c'/> For interior holes, counting neighboring live blocks gives twice M equals B plus two C. <bookmark mark='d'/> A uniformly selected free creates a hole with probability A over N and removes one with probability C over N. Freeing B changes neither count. <bookmark mark='e'/> If allocation consumes an entire existing hole with probability one minus p, it removes that hole. <bookmark mark='f'/> Stationary expected gains and losses therefore give A minus C approximately equal to one minus p times N, and M approximately one half p N. This counts holes, not their total bytes, and is not a worst-case guarantee for arbitrary workloads.
c2157c8bd8f4.zh: 克努特的五十百分比法则，是在特定假设下的统计平衡论证。<bookmark mark='a'/>考虑大致平稳、相邻空洞立即合并、活动块数为 N、且均匀选择释放对象的堆。p 表示分配时拆分现有空洞的概率。简化推导忽略边界和堆扩展修正。<bookmark mark='b'/>按零、一、两个邻居空闲，把活动块分成 A、B、C。<bookmark mark='c'/>对内部空洞数相邻活动块，得到二 M 等于 B 加二 C。<bookmark mark='d'/>均匀释放以 A 除以 N 的概率创建空洞，以 C 除以 N 的概率减少一个空洞；释放 B 不改变空洞数。<bookmark mark='e'/>若分配以一减 p 的概率用尽现有空洞，就减少一个空洞。<bookmark mark='f'/>平稳期望的增减平衡给出 A 减 C 约等于一减 p 乘 N，进而 M 约等于二分之一 p N。它统计空洞个数，不是空闲总字节，也不是任意负载的最坏情况保证。

f32712e850a9.en: The simulation tests whether this approximation is useful for a specified workload. <bookmark mark='a'/> We hold 200, 1,000 or 3,000 live blocks, repeatedly free one uniformly at random and allocate a uniformly chosen size from sixteen through two thousand bytes. Hole counts are averaged after warm-up; the recorded p includes the full run. <bookmark mark='b'/> The displayed holes-per-block ratios are close to p over two, with small differences from finite sampling, boundaries and heap growth. Agreement on this workload supports this approximation here. It neither validates arbitrary lifetime correlations nor predicts how many bytes those holes occupy.
f32712e850a9.zh: 模拟检验的是这个近似对指定负载是否有用。<bookmark mark='a'/>保持200、1,000或3,000个活动块，反复均匀随机释放一个，再从十六到两千字节均匀选择新大小。空洞数在预热后取平均，记录的 p 则覆盖整次运行。<bookmark mark='b'/>显示的每块空洞数与 p 的一半接近；有限采样、边界和堆扩展带来小差异。这支持该负载下的近似，并未验证任意生命周期相关性，也不预测这些空洞占多少字节。

fad9467244ad.en: Average-case balance does not prevent bad allocation sequences. <bookmark mark='a'/> Robson's classical lower bounds concern online, nonmoving allocation with a bound M on simultaneously live storage and a largest-to-smallest block-size ratio n. The leading growth is proportional to M log n; exact constants and finite corrections depend on the theorem's model. The plotted one plus half log base two n is our illustrative reference curve. <bookmark mark='b'/> Our constructed trace fills with small blocks, frees selected blocks while keeping holes too small for the next size, then doubles that size. <bookmark mark='c'/> On the implemented first-fit and best-fit policies, the measured heap follows this curve: from M to four and a half M as total block size grows from 32 to 4,096 bytes, so n is 128. This finite replay is not a proof against every allocator. <bookmark mark='d'/> The general impossibility result needs a strategy-dependent adversary and its proof. Moving objects, restricting lifetimes or changing the allocation model changes the assumptions. A compacting collector must also find or redirect references safely.
fad9467244ad.zh: 平均情况的平衡不能阻止恶劣分配序列。<bookmark mark='a'/>罗布森的经典下界针对在线、不移动对象的分配模型，M 限制同时活动的存储，n 是最大与最小块大小之比。主导增长与 M log n 成正比；确切常数和有限修正依赖定理模型。图上的一加二分之一以二为底的 log n，是此处的示意参考曲线。<bookmark mark='b'/>构造轨迹先填入小块，再选择性释放，使空洞仍小于下一种大小，然后把大小翻倍。<bookmark mark='c'/>对实现的首次适配和最佳适配，实测堆沿这条曲线增长：总块大小从32到4,096字节，n 为128，堆从 M 增至四点五 M。有限重放并不是针对所有分配器的证明。<bookmark mark='d'/>一般的不可能性结论需要依赖分配策略的对手及其证明。移动对象、约束生命周期或改变分配模型，都会改变假设。压缩收集器还必须安全找到或重定向引用。

67735cb783f6.en: Now the same story on a real machine. <bookmark mark='a'/> Two C files. main uses a function, count, and a variable, total, that live in the other file, and it has data of its own: a pointer to a string, and a counter private to the file. <bookmark mark='b'/> lib defines count and total, and one weak variable we will come back to. <bookmark mark='c'/> Each file is compiled on its own into an object file, and then the two are linked into a program. We compiled them on this computer and read the object files with the standard tool, readelf.
67735cb783f6.zh: 现在在一台真实的机器上把这个故事再讲一遍。<bookmark mark='a'/>两个 C 文件。main 用到一个函数 count 和一个变量 total，它们住在另一个文件里；它也有自己的数据：一个指向字符串的指针，和一个文件私有的计数器。<bookmark mark='b'/>lib 定义了 count 和 total，还有一个弱变量，我们待会儿再说它。<bookmark mark='c'/>每个文件单独编译成一个目标文件，然后两者链接成一个程序。我们在这台计算机上编译它们，并用标准工具 readelf 读这些目标文件。

bde0122df2ab.en: An object file is a set of named sections. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here are main dot o's. The machine code is in one section, the string constants in a read-only one. The pointer greeting gets a section of its own, because its value, the address of the string, is not known yet. The private counter goes in bss: a section that records only its size, since it starts as zeros and needs no space in the file. Then two sections of relocations, the holes and what fills them, and the symbol table with its names. <bookmark mark='b'/> The format is ELF, from AT and T's System V in 1988, used today by Linux, the BSDs and most game consoles. Pebble's object files are a toy version of it.
bde0122df2ab.zh: 目标文件是一组有名字的节。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是 main.o 的。机器码在一个节里，字符串常量在一个只读节里。指针 greeting 有自己的一个节，因为它的值，也就是那个字符串的地址，现在还不知道。私有的计数器放进 bss：这个节只记下大小，因为它从全零开始，在文件里不占空间。然后是两个重定位节，也就是那些洞和填洞的东西，还有带着名字的符号表。<bookmark mark='b'/>这种格式叫 ELF，出自 1988 年美国电话电报公司的 System V，今天 Linux、各个 BSD 和大多数游戏机都在用。Pebble 的目标文件是它的一个玩具版。

83a7e54bfd5e.en: The symbol table says what each file offers and what it needs. <bookmark mark='a'/> main dot o defines main and greeting as global symbols, visible to other files, and the counter as local. It lists total, count and the C library's printf as undefined: used here, defined elsewhere. lib dot o defines count and total, globally, and verbose as weak. And it needs strlen: the optimizer recognised count's loop as a string length and replaced it with a call to the library. <bookmark mark='b'/> The relocations say exactly which bytes depend on which symbol, and how: here, a 32-bit distance from the instruction to the target, a call that may go through a table we meet in chapter eleven, or a whole 64-bit address for the pointer.
83a7e54bfd5e.zh: 符号表说明每个文件提供什么、需要什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>main.o 把 main 和 greeting 定义为全局符号，其他文件看得见；计数器则是局部的。它把 total、count 和 C 库的 printf 列为未定义：这里用到，别处定义。lib.o 全局地定义了 count 和 total，并把 verbose 定义为弱符号。它还需要 strlen：优化器认出 count 的循环是在求字符串长度，就把它换成了一次库调用。<bookmark mark='b'/>重定位精确地说明哪些字节依赖哪个符号、以什么方式依赖：这里有从指令到目标的 32 位距离，有可能经过一张表的调用，那张表我们在第十一章会见到，还有给指针用的完整 64 位地址。

a0efd16a62e9.en: For this static-link example, distinguish definitions from references and binding strength. <bookmark mark='a'/> An ordinary referenced strong symbol must resolve to a definition in the final link. Unresolved weak references have special platform rules and can resolve to zero. <bookmark mark='b'/> Multiple ordinary strong definitions are an error in this example. <bookmark mark='c'/> A selected strong definition takes precedence over weak definitions. <bookmark mark='d'/> If only weak definitions exist, the linker selects one under its rules; source code should not depend on an unspecified choice among differing implementations. <bookmark mark='e'/> Leaving out lib produces undefined references; including it twice produces duplicate strong definitions. Weak defaults are one override mechanism. Dynamic symbol interposition and library-specific hooks have related but different resolution rules.
a0efd16a62e9.zh: 对这个静态链接例子，要区分定义、引用和绑定强度。<bookmark mark='a'/>最终链接时，普通引用的强符号必须解析到定义。未解析的弱引用有平台专门规则，可以解析为零。<bookmark mark='b'/>在这里出现多个普通强定义会报错。<bookmark mark='c'/>选定的强定义优先于弱定义。<bookmark mark='d'/>如果只有弱定义，链接器按规则选择一个；源程序不应依赖不同实现之间未指定的选择。<bookmark mark='e'/>省略 lib 会产生未定义引用，重复加入会产生重复强定义。弱默认定义是一种覆盖机制；动态符号插桩与库专用钩子有相关但不同的解析规则。

01741d3bce89.en: Chapter ten. Linking, step by step.
01741d3bce89.zh: 第十章。一步一步地链接。

614e4fa3bfbd.en: Now our own linker, on the Job's four object files. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each file says what it defines and what it needs. main defines start and needs getc, lookup and report. The table defines lookup and report and needs alloc, putc and printnum. alloc and io need nothing. <bookmark mark='b'/> The first job is to match every need to exactly one definition. Here, every name is defined once, so each gets an address. <bookmark mark='c'/> Leave out the allocator, or include it twice, and Pebble's linker refuses, with the same two complaints this machine's linker gave.
614e4fa3bfbd.zh: 现在用我们自己的链接器，处理任务的四个目标文件。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个文件都说明自己定义了什么、需要什么。main 定义了 start，需要 getc、lookup 和 report。表定义了 lookup 和 report，需要 alloc、putc 和 printnum。alloc 和 io 什么都不需要。<bookmark mark='b'/>第一件事是把每个需求和恰好一个定义配上对。这里每个名字都只定义了一次，所以每个都得到一个地址。<bookmark mark='c'/>漏掉分配器，或者把它放进去两次，Pebble 的链接器就会拒绝，抱怨的和这台机器的链接器一模一样。

fa9d71300b97.en: Step two: decide where everything goes. <bookmark mark='a'/> The linker lays out all the files' code first, one after another in the order the files were given, each aligned to sixteen bytes. Then all their data. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then the bss sections, which take addresses but no bytes in the file: here, the allocator's three hundred and eighty-four kilobytes of heap. <bookmark mark='c'/> So the program file is eight hundred and sixty-four bytes, but the program in memory is almost four hundred kilobytes. Now that every section has an address, so does every symbol.
fa9d71300b97.zh: 第二步：决定每样东西放在哪里。<bookmark mark='a'/>链接器先摆放所有文件的代码，按给出文件的顺序一个接一个，每段按十六字节对齐。然后是它们全部的数据。<bookmark mark='b'/>再然后是 bss 节，它们占地址，但在文件里不占字节：这里是分配器那三百八十四千字节的堆。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以程序文件只有八百六十四个字节，内存里的程序却将近四百千字节。既然每个节都有了地址，每个符号也就有了。

59ef29d7108c.en: Position-independent code can run at different load addresses. <bookmark mark='a'/> On this x86-64 example, many local references use instruction-pointer-relative addressing. References requiring dynamic resolution can use the global offset table, filled or relocated by the loader. Not every address lives in that table. <bookmark mark='b'/> A traditional external function call can pass through a procedure linkage table stub and a GOT slot. <bookmark mark='c'/> With lazy binding enabled, the first call invokes the dynamic resolver, which looks up the symbol and updates the slot. <bookmark mark='d'/> Later calls use the resolved destination. Eager binding resolves such slots at startup, and options such as no-PLT generate other call sequences. A PLT32 relocation in an object permits linker handling of a call; it does not prove that the final call must use lazy binding.
59ef29d7108c.zh: 位置无关代码可以在不同装载地址运行。<bookmark mark='a'/>在这个 x86-64 例子里，许多局部引用使用相对指令指针寻址；需要动态解析的引用可以使用由装载器填写或重定位的全局偏移表，并非所有地址都放在表中。<bookmark mark='b'/>传统外部函数调用可以经过过程链接表桩和 GOT 槽位。<bookmark mark='c'/>启用延迟绑定时，首次调用进入动态解析器，查找符号并更新槽位。<bookmark mark='d'/>后续调用使用解析后的目标。立即绑定会在启动时解析这些槽位，no-PLT 等选项也能生成其他调用序列。目标文件中的 PLT32 重定位允许链接器处理调用，并不能证明最终调用必须延迟绑定。

d3e9311b86a8.en: Dynamic linking has a remarkable side effect: you can replace a library function without touching the program. <bookmark mark='a'/> Set LD_PRELOAD to a library of your own, and the dynamic linker searches it before the C library. <bookmark mark='b'/> So when Perl calls malloc, it reaches our malloc, which writes a record of the request and then calls the real one, found by asking for the next definition of the same name. <bookmark mark='c'/> That is how chapter six recorded almost two hundred and seventy-seven thousand events from an unmodified Perl. <bookmark mark='d'/> Profilers and memory-leak checkers use the same trick, and so, sometimes, does malware.
d3e9311b86a8.zh: 动态链接有一个了不起的副作用：你可以不碰程序就替换一个库函数。<bookmark mark='a'/>把 LD_PRELOAD 设成你自己的一个库，动态链接器就会先在它里面找，再找 C 库。<bookmark mark='b'/>于是 Perl 调用 malloc 时，到达的是我们的 malloc，它记下这个请求，再调用真正的那个，后者是通过请求同名的下一个定义找到的。<bookmark mark='c'/>第六章就是这样从一个没改过的 Perl 里记下将近二十七万七千个事件的。<bookmark mark='d'/>性能分析器和内存泄漏检查器用的是同一个技巧，有时恶意软件也是。

9d311d66588c.en: Chapter twelve. Loading and the address space.
9d311d66588c.zh: 第十二章。装载与地址空间。

f003b8e873f7.en: This is a schematic built from one Linux process's proc self maps snapshot. <bookmark mark='a'/> It orders selected mappings by virtual address: executable segments, a brk heap region, libraries and stack. Large allocations can use other mappings, and the layout is neither universal nor drawn to scale. Mapping virtual space does not mean every byte occupies physical RAM. <bookmark mark='b'/> The actual snapshot records permissions per mapping. In this build the code is executable and not writable; ordinary data and stack are writable and not executable. The schematic groups library mappings for readability, although those mappings have different permissions. Part 32 connects virtual mappings to physical pages.
f003b8e873f7.zh: 这是根据一个 Linux 进程的 proc self maps 快照绘制的示意图。<bookmark mark='a'/>选定映射按虚拟地址排列：可执行段、brk 堆区域、库和栈。大分配可能使用其他映射，布局并不通用，也不按比例绘制。映射虚拟空间不意味着每个字节都占用物理内存。<bookmark mark='b'/>实际快照逐个映射记录权限。本构建的代码可执行但不可写，普通数据和栈可写但不可执行。为便于阅读，示意图把库映射分组，实际各映射的权限不同。第32部分会连接虚拟映射与物理页。

e07bd097b597.en: The compiled probe prints five kinds of address across three runs. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here the PIE program, global, heap, stack and printf addresses vary. The executable's PIE configuration matters: non-PIE text can remain fixed while other regions move. <bookmark mark='b'/> Address-space layout randomization makes useful addresses less predictable; the PaX project introduced an influential implementation in 2001. Coverage and entropy depend on platform and configuration. Leaks, limited entropy and repeated guesses can weaken it. <bookmark mark='c'/> The final panel records whether disabling randomization with setarch was permitted. This environment may reject that request. A rejected request is not evidence of a successful fixed-address comparison, and ASLR does not itself prevent an out-of-bounds write.
e07bd097b597.zh: 编译的探针在三次运行中打印五类地址。<bookmark mark='a'/>这里 PIE 程序、全局变量、堆、栈和 printf 的地址发生变化。可执行文件是否采用 PIE 很重要：非 PIE 的代码可能固定，其他区域仍然移动。<bookmark mark='b'/>地址空间随机化降低有用地址的可预测性；PaX 项目2001年引入了有影响力的实现。覆盖范围和熵取决于平台和配置，地址泄露、有限熵和重复猜测都能削弱它。<bookmark mark='c'/>最后一栏记录 setarch 禁用随机化的请求是否获准，本环境可能拒绝。请求被拒绝不能证明固定地址对照成功；ASLR 本身也不阻止越界写入。

341013f8bfb8.en: C leaves some operations undefined. <bookmark mark='a'/> Overflowing a signed integer, reading past the end of an array, dereferencing a null pointer, using memory after freeing it. <bookmark mark='b'/> For these the standard does not say the program crashes, or gives a wrong answer. It says nothing at all: any behaviour is allowed. <bookmark mark='c'/> There were reasons. Machines handled overflow differently, and checking every array access costs time. <bookmark mark='d'/> But modern optimizers draw a sharper conclusion: since a correct program never does these things, the compiler may assume they never happen, and optimize on that assumption. We measured what that does on this computer.
341013f8bfb8.zh: C 把一些操作留作未定义。<bookmark mark='a'/>有符号整数溢出、读过数组的末尾、解引用空指针、释放之后还用那块内存。<bookmark mark='b'/>对这些，标准并不说程序会崩溃，或者给出错的答案。它什么也不说：任何行为都允许。<bookmark mark='c'/>这样做有它的理由。不同的机器处理溢出的方式不同，而检查每次数组访问要花时间。<bookmark mark='d'/>但现代的优化器得出了一个更尖锐的结论：既然正确的程序从不做这些事，编译器就可以假定它们永远不会发生，并按这个假定来优化。我们在这台计算机上测了这会带来什么。

3d025d2f6e4b.en: Signed overflow separates C semantics from a particular instruction's arithmetic. <bookmark mark='a'/> At INT_MAX, evaluating signed x plus one is undefined in ordinary C. <bookmark mark='b'/> The host instruction set has wrapping addition, but this expression is not required to compile into that instruction. gcc can return one for x plus one greater than x because every defined signed addition satisfies the comparison. <bookmark mark='c'/> The table records the loop-trip counts produced by these exact builds. Once the loop overflows, ordinary C imposes no portable trip count; optimization-level differences are observations, not language guarantees. <bookmark mark='d'/> gcc's fwrapv option supplies wrapping semantics for the relevant signed arithmetic in these examples. That implementation option changes the assumptions; it does not make unrelated bounds or lifetime violations defined.
3d025d2f6e4b.zh: 有符号溢出说明，C 语义与某条指令的算术并不相同。<bookmark mark='a'/>在 INT_MAX 处，普通 C 中计算有符号 x 加一属于未定义行为。<bookmark mark='b'/>主机指令集有回绕加法，但这个表达式不必编译成那条指令。gcc 可以对 x 加一大于 x 直接返回一，因为所有有定义的有符号加法都满足这个比较。<bookmark mark='c'/>表中是这些特定构建实际得到的循环次数。一旦循环溢出，普通 C 不再规定可移植的次数；优化级别之间的差异是观察，不是语言保证。<bookmark mark='d'/>gcc 的 fwrapv 选项为这些例子中相关的有符号算术提供回绕语义。实现选项改变了假设，却不会让其他越界或生命周期违规变得有定义。

76f5ec1f4c09.en: Second, a null check. <bookmark mark='a'/> This function reads through a pointer, and only then checks whether the pointer was null. <bookmark mark='b'/> Without optimization, gcc compiles both: the load, the comparison, the early return. <bookmark mark='c'/> With optimization, the whole function is one load and a return. The reasoning: the program already dereferenced p, and dereferencing null is undefined, so p cannot be null, so the check can never fire. <bookmark mark='d'/> This is not hypothetical. In 2009 exactly this pattern in the Linux kernel's network tunnel driver let the compiler delete a null check, and the result was exploitable. Linux has been built ever since with a flag that forbids this particular optimization. The lesson of the chapter: in C, the program you meant and the program you wrote can differ, and the optimizer will take the one you wrote at its word.
76f5ec1f4c09.zh: 再看一次空指针检查。<bookmark mark='a'/>这个函数先通过一个指针读数，然后才检查这个指针是不是空的。<bookmark mark='b'/>不开优化，gcc 两样都编译出来：取数、比较、提前返回。<bookmark mark='c'/>开了优化，整个函数就是一次取数加一次返回。理由是：程序已经解引用了 p，而解引用空指针是未定义的，所以 p 不可能是空的，所以这个检查永远不会触发。<bookmark mark='d'/>这不是假想。2009 年，Linux 内核网络隧道驱动里恰好就是这个模式，让编译器删掉了一个空指针检查，结果可以被利用。从那以后，Linux 一直用一个禁止这种优化的选项来编译。这一章的教训是：在 C 里，你想写的程序和你写下的程序可能不一样，而优化器只认你写下的那个。

49f368995446.en: The practical defence is to catch undefined behaviour as it happens. <bookmark mark='a'/> Compile with the undefined-behaviour sanitizer, and our overflowing addition stops to report it: the largest int plus one cannot be represented in type int. <bookmark mark='b'/> AddressSanitizer catches memory errors: a write just past the end of a sixty-four-byte block from malloc, <bookmark mark='c'/> a read from a block already freed, <bookmark mark='d'/> and a write past an array on the stack, the very bug of the next chapter. Each report gives the address, the line of source, and for the heap, where the block was allocated.
49f368995446.zh: 实用的防御，是在未定义行为发生时就抓住它。<bookmark mark='a'/>用未定义行为检测器编译，我们那个溢出的加法就会停下来报告：最大的 int 加一，无法用 int 类型表示。<bookmark mark='b'/>AddressSanitizer 抓的是内存错误：在 malloc 给的一个六十四字节块的末尾之后写一个元素，<bookmark mark='c'/>从一个已经释放的块里读，<bookmark mark='d'/>以及越过栈上一个数组的末尾去写，正是下一章的那个错误。每份报告都给出地址、源代码的行号，对堆还会说明那个块是在哪里分配的。

a11d7153780c.en: Here is the greeting program from the start of this part, on Pebble. <bookmark mark='a'/> greet makes an eighty-byte frame. At the bottom, a sixty-four-byte buffer for the name; near the top, the saved return address, the way back to the caller. <bookmark mark='b'/> It passes the buffer to gets, which, like C's gets, copies input until it sees a newline, however long that is. <bookmark mark='c'/> The copy runs upward, from the bottom of the buffer towards the saved return address. So a name longer than seventy-six bytes reaches it.
a11d7153780c.zh: 这是本部分开头那个打招呼的程序，放在 Pebble 上。<bookmark mark='a'/>greet 建一个八十字节的栈帧。底部是装名字的六十四字节缓冲区；靠近顶部是保存的返回地址，回到调用者的路。<bookmark mark='b'/>它把缓冲区交给 gets，后者和 C 的 gets 一样，一直复制输入直到看见换行，不管有多长。<bookmark mark='c'/>复制是向上进行的，从缓冲区底部朝保存的返回地址去。所以一个长过七十六字节的名字就会碰到它。

865e8e5153b7.en: Modern toolchains offer several defenses, with coverage determined by the build and platform. Our Pebble variants illustrate their mechanisms. <bookmark mark='a'/> A canary checked before return can detect this contiguous overwrite, provided the attacker cannot reproduce the expected value. It does not protect every memory access. <bookmark mark='b'/> A non-executable stack stops this attempt to execute injected stack bytes. It does not stop the overwrite itself. <bookmark mark='c'/> ASLR makes the injected destination harder to predict; it needs sufficient entropy and resistance to leaks. <bookmark mark='d'/> A bounds-carrying pointer can reject the first write outside this buffer; the Frontier adds a miniature check. <bookmark mark='e'/> These defenses address different failure modes. Code-reuse attacks can use executable fragments already present, including return-oriented programming. Layered mitigation complements bounds and lifetime safety; no universal claim that every binary enables all of these is warranted.
865e8e5153b7.zh: 现代工具链提供多种防护，覆盖范围由构建和平台决定。Pebble 的变体展示它们的机制。<bookmark mark='a'/>返回前检查金丝雀，可以发现这次连续覆盖，前提是攻击者无法复现预期值；它并不保护每一次内存访问。<bookmark mark='b'/>不可执行栈阻止这次执行栈上注入字节的尝试，却不阻止覆盖本身。<bookmark mark='c'/>ASLR 让注入目标更难预测，但需要足够熵和抗泄露能力。<bookmark mark='d'/>携带边界的指针可以拒绝首次越过这个缓冲区的写入，前沿章节会添加一个微型检查。<bookmark mark='e'/>这些防护针对不同失效模式。代码复用攻击可以使用已有可执行片段，包括返回导向编程。分层缓解与边界、生命周期安全相互补充，不能声称每个二进制都启用了全部防护。

ee45dceb31ce.zh: 第十五章。链接起来的任务。

fe35489b6b32.en: Here is the Job written the way a compiler would write it. <bookmark mark='a'/> main reads letters into a buffer in its own stack frame. The table is a linked list of sixteen-byte nodes on the heap, kept in the order words were first seen, so ties break exactly as before. The allocator just bumps a pointer through three hundred and eighty-four kilobytes of bss, never freeing anything, which is all the Job needs. And the input and output routines include printnum, which keeps its digits in a small buffer in its frame. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each node holds a pointer to the next, a pointer to the word's letters, its length and its count. <bookmark mark='c'/> And every function obeys the calling convention of chapter four.
fe35489b6b32.zh: 这是按编译器的写法写出来的任务。<bookmark mark='a'/>main 把字母读进它自己栈帧里的一个缓冲区。表是堆上十六字节节点组成的链表，按单词第一次出现的次序排列，所以平局的打破方式和以前完全一样。分配器只是在 bss 的三百八十四千字节里往前推一个指针，从不释放任何东西，任务也只需要这些。输入输出例程里有 printnum，它把数字放在自己栈帧里的一个小缓冲区中。<bookmark mark='b'/>每个节点装着指向下一个节点的指针、指向单词字母的指针、它的长度和它的计数。<bookmark mark='c'/>每个函数都遵守第四章的调用约定。

8de67430d409.en: How does it compare with Part 6's single hand-written file? <bookmark mark='a'/> On a paragraph, the first chapter of Pride and Prejudice, and twenty thousand bytes, the output is identical every time. <bookmark mark='b'/> On the paragraph, version one is a few percent slower: every byte of input now costs a function call and return. <bookmark mark='c'/> On longer texts it is faster, by eleven percent at twenty thousand bytes, because following a next pointer takes one instruction fewer per entry than counting through an array. <bookmark mark='d'/> The stack never went deeper than three hundred and twenty bytes. <bookmark mark='e'/> Structure, it turns out, costs almost nothing here. But the algorithm has not changed: each word still pays for a scan of the vocabulary. Part 13's compiler will write this program automatically, and Act Four will change the algorithm.
8de67430d409.zh: 它和第6部分那个手写的单文件比怎么样？<bookmark mark='a'/>在一个段落、《傲慢与偏见》的第一章和两万字节上，输出每次都完全相同。<bookmark mark='b'/>在那个段落上，版本一慢了几个百分点：现在每个输入字节都要付出一次函数调用和返回。<bookmark mark='c'/>在更长的文本上它更快，两万字节时快百分之十一，因为顺着 next 指针走，每个表项比在数组里数过去少一条指令。<bookmark mark='d'/>栈从没深过三百二十个字节。<bookmark mark='e'/>原来结构在这里几乎不花什么。但算法没有变：每个词仍要为扫一遍词汇表付出代价。第13部分的编译器会自动写出这个程序，而第四幕会改变算法。

e711a7b8b505.en: Ordinary address arithmetic does not automatically enforce object bounds. <bookmark mark='a'/> CHERI associates capabilities with address, bounds, permissions and a protected validity tag. This diagram is conceptual; encodings vary. Morello uses 128-bit capabilities plus a tag, with compressed bounds rather than these literal separate fields. <bookmark mark='b'/> Capability-based accesses check authority. Derivation cannot increase authority beyond what is held, although the cursor can move within the rules; bounds need not become strictly smaller on every operation. Hybrid systems can also retain ordinary pointers. Arm's Morello prototype arrived in 2022. <bookmark mark='c'/> Pebble's miniature model attaches exact sixty-four-byte bounds to greet's buffer pointer. It is a teaching model, not a complete CHERI implementation. <bookmark mark='d'/> It traps this attack at the sixty-fifth byte and still greets Ada. Spatial bounds alone do not generally solve use-after-free: temporal safety needs additional mechanisms.
e711a7b8b505.zh: 普通地址运算不会自动强制对象边界。<bookmark mark='a'/>CHERI 把地址、边界、权限和受保护的有效标签关联为能力。图是概念示意，实际编码各不相同。Morello 使用128位能力加标签，并压缩编码边界，并不是图中的独立字段。<bookmark mark='b'/>基于能力的访问检查权限；派生不能扩大已有权限，但游标可以按规则移动，并非每次操作都必须严格缩小边界。混合系统也可以保留普通指针。Arm 的 Morello 原型于2022年问世。<bookmark mark='c'/>Pebble 的微型模型给 greet 缓冲区指针附加精确的六十四字节边界。它是教学模型，并非完整 CHERI 实现。<bookmark mark='d'/>模型在第六十五字节拦截此次攻击，仍能问候 Ada。仅有空间边界一般不能解决释放后使用，时间安全还需其他机制。

9f30193428ae.en: Compiler correctness requires an explicit source semantics and a stated proof boundary. <bookmark mark='a'/> The theorem connects behaviors in source and target languages, including how undefined source behavior limits the guarantee. <bookmark mark='b'/> CompCert proves semantic preservation for its verified compilation passes and supported C subset. Its theorem relies on assumptions about unverified interfaces and tools; it is not a proof of every C program or every surrounding component. <bookmark mark='c'/> Cerberus explores executable models of C, including the difficult interactions of pointers, objects and real implementation practice. <bookmark mark='d'/> Pointer provenance asks which storage instance a pointer may access, even when numeric addresses coincide. Standards work and implementation models continue to refine these rules; a proposal is not automatically an adopted standard. <bookmark mark='e'/> Research compares formal guarantees, compatibility with existing code and optimizer behavior. We should name the particular semantics and version before claiming that all three agree.
9f30193428ae.zh: 编译器正确性需要明确的源语言语义和证明边界。<bookmark mark='a'/>定理连接源语言与目标语言的行为，也要说明源程序未定义行为如何限制保证。<bookmark mark='b'/>CompCert 为经过验证的编译阶段和所支持的 C 子集证明语义保持。定理依赖未验证接口和工具的假设，并不证明每个 C 程序或周边组件都正确。<bookmark mark='c'/>Cerberus 探索 C 的可执行模型，包括指针、对象与实际实现惯例之间的复杂关系。<bookmark mark='d'/>指针来源追问指针可以访问哪个存储实例，即使两个数值地址相同。标准工作和实现模型仍在细化规则，提案并不自动等于已采用标准。<bookmark mark='e'/>研究比较形式保证、既有代码兼容性和优化器行为。在声称三者一致之前，应该指明具体语义及其版本。

7a34e48584ef.en: Allocator research depends strongly on the model and workload. <bookmark mark='a'/> Robson's lower bounds and policy-specific upper and lower bounds require their own hypotheses; our eight-phase trace establishes only the displayed measurements for our implementations. <bookmark mark='b'/> Johnstone and Wilson's 1998 study found low fragmentation for selected policies and measured programs. Our Perl replay is one additional workload, and its peak ratio includes headers and alignment. Neither establishes that all programs stay near the average. <bookmark mark='c'/> Lifetime correlations, size distributions, locality and concurrency help explain behavior; finding useful predictive models remains a research question, rather than a claim that no model exists. <bookmark mark='d'/> Temporal safety is another challenge. Quarantines delay reuse, type segregation limits some reuse patterns, and checked smart-pointer schemes protect selected references. Each has coverage and overhead limits; a spatial capability by itself does not revoke every stale reference.
7a34e48584ef.zh: 分配器研究高度依赖模型和负载。<bookmark mark='a'/>罗布森下界与特定策略的上下界各有假设；我们的八阶段轨迹只确立所实现策略的显示测量。<bookmark mark='b'/>约翰斯通与威尔逊1998年的研究，在选定策略和实测程序中发现较低碎片。Perl 重放是另一条负载，峰值比包含头部与对齐，二者都不能证明所有程序接近平均情况。<bookmark mark='c'/>生命周期相关性、大小分布、局部性与并发有助于解释行为。建立有用的预测模型仍是研究问题，而不是断言根本不存在模型。<bookmark mark='d'/>时间安全是另一挑战。隔离区延迟复用，类型隔离限制某些复用模式，受检查的智能指针保护选定引用。各自都有覆盖范围和开销限制，空间能力本身不会撤销所有过期引用。

6ea0ef254bfd.en: We followed a program from source to a process. The diagrams connected byte layout and pointer arithmetic to branches, frames and calling conventions. Five simulated allocators replayed one recorded Perl trace. Knuth's balance argument matched that workload approximately, while an adversarial trace illustrated the worst-case question without proving a general theorem. Pebble gained a linker and loader; compiled host examples exposed object sections, dynamic references and virtual mappings. Finally, a toy stack overwrite showed how distinct defenses interrupt different parts of an attack.
6ea0ef254bfd.zh: 我们从源代码一路追到进程。图示把字节布局与指针运算，连接到分支、栈帧和调用约定。五种模拟分配器重放同一条 Perl 轨迹。克努特的平衡论证近似符合指定负载，对抗轨迹则展示最坏情况问题，并未证明一般定理。Pebble 获得链接器和装载器；主机编译例子展示目标节、动态引用与虚拟映射。最后，玩具栈覆盖展示不同防护如何打断攻击的不同环节。

69c7bc386eb8.en: These mechanisms return throughout the course. Part 13 builds a compiler that emits structured calls and references. Part 15 builds runtime reclamation, including moving collectors whose assumptions differ from nonmoving allocation. Part 31 adds exceptional control flow, signals and system calls, and Part 32 connects virtual addresses to pages. Part 54 studies program and compiler correctness under explicit semantics. Part 55 studies code-reuse attacks and the trust placed in our tools.
69c7bc386eb8.zh: 这些机制会贯穿课程。第13部分搭建编译器，生成有结构的调用与引用。第15部分搭建运行时回收机制，包括假设不同于不移动分配的移动式收集器。第31部分加入异常控制流、信号与系统调用，第32部分把虚拟地址连接到页。第54部分在明确语义下研究程序和编译器正确性。第55部分研究代码复用攻击，以及我们对工具的信任。

ab7b31899ba1.en: In practice, inspect a backtrace with the build's symbols and unwinding information. Use sanitizers and memory-checking tools to find exercised classes of errors, while recognizing their instrumentation and coverage limits. Read linker diagnostics separately from compiler diagnostics: undefined references, duplicate symbols and archive ordering are concrete clues. Benchmark allocator choices on representative workloads before claiming a speedup. Check which stack, page, randomization and control-flow defenses your platform and build actually enable; defaults and coverage vary.
ab7b31899ba1.zh: 实践中，要结合构建的符号和展开信息检查回溯。使用检测器和内存检查工具寻找实际执行到的错误，同时理解插桩与覆盖限制。把链接诊断和编译诊断分别阅读：未定义引用、重复符号和静态库顺序都是具体线索。更换分配器前，用代表性负载测量，再判断加速。检查平台和构建实际启用了哪些栈、页、随机化与控制流防护；默认值和覆盖范围各不相同。

cfa2e7bd6779.en: The notes give six exercises and worked guidance. The fifth implements an allocator in Pebble assembly and compares a trace replay under identical header, alignment and splitting rules. The research exercise asks you to state a precise nonmoving-allocation model, locate the relevant upper and lower bounds, and explore small adversarial cases. A simulation can reveal a counterexample or motivate a conjecture; it cannot establish a universal worst-case theorem by itself.
cfa2e7bd6779.zh: 笔记给出六道练习及解答指导。第五题在 Pebble 汇编中实现分配器，并在头部、对齐与拆分规则一致的前提下比较轨迹重放。研究练习要求先明确不移动分配模型，找到相关上下界，再探索小规模对抗案例。模拟可以发现反例或启发猜想，却不能独自确立普遍的最坏情况定理。

db0aab6bc010.en: Next time. To build Part 13's compiler we first need the theory of reading text: regular expressions, finite automata and grammars, and the parsers built from them. Part 12, Languages and Automata.
db0aab6bc010.zh: 下一次。要搭第13部分的编译器，我们先需要阅读文本的理论：正则表达式、有限自动机和文法，以及由它们构造的语法分析器。第12部分，语言与自动机。

9bd24692775d.en: The books and papers this part follows are on screen and in the notes. Thank you for watching.
9bd24692775d.zh: 这一部分依据的书和论文都在屏幕上和笔记里。感谢观看。

11ee488bb285.en: The initial stack is an interface between the operating system and runtime startup. <bookmark mark='a'/> Our diagram simplifies a Unix-style arrangement to argument strings, an array of pointers ending in null, and an argument count. A real Linux initial stack also includes environment pointers and an auxiliary vector, with architecture-specific alignment. <bookmark mark='b'/> The entry routine runs before main and passes the arguments according to the platform's conventions. It is runtime startup, not a universal direct loader call to main. <bookmark mark='c'/> Pebble's small loader implements the argument-only teaching layout and supplies argc and argv in a0 and a1. Its tests check the strings and pointer array; it is not a complete implementation of Linux process startup.
11ee488bb285.zh: 初始栈是操作系统与运行时启动代码之间的接口。<bookmark mark='a'/>图中把 Unix 风格布局简化为参数字符串、以空指针结束的指针数组，以及参数个数。实际 Linux 初始栈还包含环境指针和辅助向量，并有架构相关对齐。<bookmark mark='b'/>入口例程先于 main 运行，按平台约定传入参数。这是运行时启动，并非装载器普遍直接调用 main。<bookmark mark='c'/>Pebble 的小装载器实现仅含参数的教学布局，用 a0 和 a1 提供 argc 与 argv。测试检查字符串和指针数组，它并未完整实现 Linux 进程启动。

c648be6899e0.en: The route through this part connects representation to behavior. <bookmark mark='a'/> Bytes, alignment, arrays and typed pointers explain where data goes. <bookmark mark='b'/> Calling conventions and frames explain how separately compiled functions cooperate. <bookmark mark='c'/> A recorded allocation trace lets us compare five simulated policies under explicit accounting rules. <bookmark mark='d'/> Object files, linking and loading connect Pebble's small implementation to compiled host examples. <bookmark mark='e'/> Finally, undefined behavior and a toy stack overwrite show why bounds, lifetime rules and defense coverage matter. Each measurement belongs to its stated program, model and build.
c648be6899e0.zh: 本部分把表示方式连接到程序行为。<bookmark mark='a'/>字节、对齐、数组和有类型指针解释数据放在哪里。<bookmark mark='b'/>调用约定与栈帧解释分别编译的函数如何合作。<bookmark mark='c'/>记录的分配轨迹，让我们在明确计费规则下比较五种模拟策略。<bookmark mark='d'/>目标文件、链接与装载，把 Pebble 的小实现连接到主机编译例子。<bookmark mark='e'/>最后，未定义行为与玩具栈覆盖说明边界、生命周期规则和防护覆盖为何重要。每个测量都属于其指定的程序、模型和构建。

dfcc03433e0d.en: Here is lookup's explicit Pebble frame. <bookmark mark='a'/> The function changes s0, s1 and s2 and calls alloc, which changes ra. It subtracts sixteen from sp and saves those four registers in the new frame. <bookmark mark='b'/> Above it is main's frame, containing the input word buffer. This drawing follows this program's downward-growing stack. <bookmark mark='c'/> Before returning, lookup restores the registers and releases its frame. These ordinary calls make the stack reflect the active call chain. Leaf functions and optimized tail calls can avoid a new frame; the next chapter compares those cases.
dfcc03433e0d.zh: 这里是 lookup 显式建立的 Pebble 栈帧。<bookmark mark='a'/>函数会修改 s0、s1、s2，并调用会改变 ra 的 alloc，所以从 sp 减去十六，把四个寄存器保存在新栈帧。<bookmark mark='b'/>它上面是 main 的栈帧，包含输入单词缓冲区。图按这个程序向下增长的栈绘制。<bookmark mark='c'/>返回前，lookup 恢复寄存器并释放栈帧。这些普通调用让栈反映活动调用链。叶函数与优化的尾调用可以不建立新栈帧，下一章会比较这些情形。
